title: Erdős #114 OQ: Explicit Lemniscate Maximizer Threshold
description: Can Tao's large-n threshold for lemniscate length maximization be made explicit? We show f(n) = 2πn for all n ≥ 1 from Danchenko's bound and the z^n-1 construction. The deeper question is about uniqueness of the maximizer.
